description: Convert Advantage Games from a static/QC showcase into the authenticated production host for all five APK cartridges, with a generic student route, server-owned persistence, and a continuous arcade loop.
deviation_notes: W0 and W1 proved package cartridges and QC. This successor owns the missing dynamic app, first-party session, production route, persistence, and safe first-five cutover boundaries; it does not mass-port another game batch.

sprint.goal: A student can sign in to Advantage Games, play any of the five shared APK cartridges through one production host, persist a completion safely, and continue directly to another game.
